name: Save The Best For Last

description.content: Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn [1] Token, up to [8].
For each Token, your basic-attack cooldown is [5%] shorter.
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose [2] Tokens.
While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.

quote: "Death has come to your little town, sheriff." -Dr. Sam Loomis
